description: This file is a PHP class named 'Topic' in the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Event' namespace, responsible for adding, editing, and deleting topics by scheduling tasks through method calls.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: A controller class managing topic events such as add, edit, and delete, by queuing tasks.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate new topic data after a topic is added.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Schedules a task to update topic data after a topic is edited.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Schedules a task to delete topic data after a topic is deleted.
